policy_note: These are provisional project-management thresholds, not universal scientific cutoffs. Thresholds must be recalibrated from benchmark evidence. Passing permits human review of a candidate; it does not prove AGI, universal correctness, source truth, or complete natural-language understanding.

forbidden_implications: trained model unless training evidence exists

next_actions: Replace synthetic fixture hashes with hashes of actual immutable source bytes and exact source spans.
Accumulate at least 20 source records from 3 documented source classes.
Build and review at least 50 source-backed logic units and 20 typed composition contracts.
Add at least 30 negative/boundary/counterexample cases and 100 reproducible tests across 3 benchmark suites.
Implement and execute deterministic build replay, holdout evaluation, mirror review, and two independent review cycles.
Recompute every count from the canonical corpus; do not infer completeness from declared totals.
